newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $1.6 bln for week of Feb 3.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $1.6 bln for week of Feb 3.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales for the week of February 3 are expected to total $1.56 billion in 66 offerings, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $275 million in 42 sales. The largest is a $30 million Fresno Unified School District, Calif., offering on February 6.
Negotiated sales total $1.29 billion in 24 offerings. The largest is a $459 million Anaheim, Calif., revenue bond offering through PaineWebber Inc.

Day to day muni bond sales total $750 million in 15 offerings for the week of February 3, which means dealers may bring the offerings to market if conditions warrant. Among those offerings are a $150 million Platte River Power Authority issue through Smith Barney Inc and a $100 million Tacoma, Wash., refunding issue through Goldman Sachs & Co.
